component.name: Hex
component.summary: Local voice dictation for your desktop

description.p: Hex transcribes speech on your device and pastes it into the application you are using. Choose a speech model to download on first use, then dictate with a keyboard shortcut.
This community package uses the unmodified official Hex release in X11 mode.

Use an X11 desktop session for shortcuts and dictation across applications. On a Wayland desktop, Xwayland limits shortcuts and paste to X11 applications. Launch at login through the desktop portal is unavailable.
The x86-64 build requires an AVX2-capable processor.
